item.title: Power Outages, NIF Controversy, Cyber Threats
item.ns0:title: Power Outages, NIF Controversy, Cyber Threats
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, frustrated residents in Stapledon Gardens and Millennium Gardens demand action as persistent power outages continue to plague local communities. The political clash over the National Investment Fund intensifies as the Opposition accuses the government of giving conflicting accounts on how public money was handled. Meanwhile, transport officials weigh in after a U.S. visitor's viral TikTok video alleging a violent assault by an illegal jet ski operator sparks national outrage. Plus, international cyber experts gather in New Providence to safeguard Bahamian maritime ports, while critical repair plans are announced for the Fresh Creek Bridge in Central Andros.
-----
